messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty page fired -> service=postgres-primary, incident=PD-10017, severity=P1. Symptoms: DB connection pool exhaustion, elevated 5xx, pgbouncer queues growing. Link: https://pagerduty.com/incidents/PD-10017

pagerduty: Auto-update: paging on-call (policy: primary->alice). Please ACK in PD to stop further escalations.

alice: Acked PD-10017. I'm looking. Observed on dashboards: pg connections 510/512, pgbouncer clients_waiting=190, api 5xx ~18% for /v1/chat and /v1/upload.

bob: I can take SSH. Quick tail of postgres log shows repeated `FATAL: sorry, too many clients already`. Pgbouncer logs: `pooler: waiting clients exceeded` and many `server_reset_query` timeouts.

carol: Likely a mix of a runaway batch job + sudden traffic spike. Two immediate mitigations: pause noncritical background jobs and restart pgbouncer poolers one at a time to avoid global outage. Also prepare to enable pgbouncer overflow.

dave: I see a scheduled analytics backfill kicked at 02:45 UTC on reporting-worker-3. I'll pause that job now via ops API.

ops-bot: request received: pause job reporting-backfill-2026-02-02 by dave. Status: success.

dave: Command executed:
```
curl -s -X POST https://ops-api.internal/jobs/reporting-backfill-2026/actions/pause -H 'Authorization: Bearer REDACTED'
{"status":"paused","job":"reporting-backfill-2026"}
```

alice: Paused. Next: bob, please rotate pgbouncer on the two app-pgbouncer nodes after draining clients. Restart one at a time.

bob: Doing pgbouncer restart on app-pgb-01:
```
ssh app-pgb-01 sudo systemctl restart pgbouncer && sudo journalctl -u pgbouncer -n 200 --no-pager
```
journal shows: `pooler: closing 120 waiting clients` then `pooler: opened 280 server connections`. clients_waiting dropped to 12.

bob: Restarted app-pgb-02 as well. Aggregate clients_waiting now ~8, postgres connections ~300/512. Query latency dropping.

carol: Redis also hit high memory in a few clusters causing higher error rates for sessions. I'm switching redis policy to allkeys-lru and raising maxmemory by 20% temporarily.

carol: Commands run:
```
redis-cli -h redis-primary CONFIG SET maxmemory 52gb
redis-cli -h redis-primary CONFIG SET maxmemory-policy allkeys-lru
```
Responses: OK, OK. Evictions started at 02:58 UTC; 5xx count decreasing.

bob: Postgres is stable but we still see long-running reporting queries. I applied a conservative statement_timeout to the reporting role to avoid hogging connections:
```
psql -c "ALTER ROLE reporting SET statement_timeout = '60s';"
```
This will prevent queries >60s.

incident-bot: PagerDuty update: acknowledged by alice. Current status: mitigated. Escalations paused.

alice: Customer impact summary: interactive features degraded for ~22 minutes. Two enterprise customers reported failures: BankWorks (high error rate on upload) and EduLabs (chat sessions dropped). CSMs notified.

dave: I've added a throttling cap to reporting-worker to limit concurrent DB connections to 5 per worker. Also adding exponential backoff to retries in the job.

carol: Monitoring notes: set alerts -> pgbouncer.clients_waiting > 50 for 2m, postgres.connections > 400 for 5m, redis.evictions > 200/min. Will create follow-up ticket for permanent pgbouncer config increase and connection pooling review.

alice: Handing lead to bob in 30 minutes for overnight watch. If PD pages again, escalate immediately.

bob: I'll own post-incident: collect pg_stat_activity samples, slow query logs, and timeline. Drafting postmortem ticket: https://confluence.internal/incidents/INC-2026-07-db-pool-exhaust

alice: Closing PD-10017 (status: resolved) after observing stable metrics for 15m. Leaving incident channel open for follow-ups. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
